jei.creeperarmor.armor_info: Full Creeper Armor prevents explosion damage, but the pieces still lose durability. When a hit would leave less than one heart, one armor piece detonates and saves you. Four charges maximum.
jei.creeperarmor.shield_info: Blocks like a normal shield. Hold use for 0.6 s to trigger one block-breaking directional blast, costing 50 of its 500 durability. Release and raise again to fire another.
jei.creeperarmor.material_info: Creeper Plate and Creeper Powder drop from defeated creepers; charged creepers drop double. Use them in equipment recipes.
